title.en: From the Oktoih to The Mountain Wreath

summary.me: Vijekovi crnogorske knjige: od prvih štampanih knjiga Đurđa Crnojevića do Njegoševih djela i prvog broja Glasa Crnogorca.
summary.en: Centuries of the Montenegrin book: from the first books printed under Đurađ Crnojević to Njegoš’s works and the first issue of Glas Crnogorca.

title.en: The Oktoih: the first printed books

text.me: Oktoisi štampani 1494. u štampariji Đurđa Crnojevića spadaju među najstarije štampane knjige južnoslovenskog prostora. Štampariju je vodio jeromonah Makarije.
text.en: The Oktoih books printed in 1494 in the press of Đurađ Crnojević are among the oldest printed books of the South Slavic lands. The press was led by hieromonk Makarije.

text.me: Petar II Petrović Njegoš objavljuje spjev Luča mikrokozma, filozofsko djelo o mjestu čovjeka u svemiru.
text.en: Petar II Petrović Njegoš publishes The Ray of the Microcosm, a philosophical poem about the place of man in the universe.

text.me: Gorski vijenac, štampan u Beču 1847, smatra se vrhuncem Njegoševog stvaralaštva i temeljnim djelom crnogorske književnosti.
text.en: The Mountain Wreath, printed in Vienna in 1847, is regarded as the peak of Njegoš’s work and a foundational text of Montenegrin literature.

text.me: List Glas Crnogorca izlazi na Cetinju od 1873. i decenijama bilježi političko i kulturno življenje Crne Gore.
text.en: The newspaper Glas Crnogorca began appearing in Cetinje in 1873 and for decades documented the political and cultural life of Montenegro.

intro.me: Izložba prati put crnogorske štampane riječi kroz četiri prelomna trenutka: Oktoih iz Crnojevića štamparije, Njegoševu Luču mikrokozma, Gorski vijenac i prvi broj Glasa Crnogorca. Svaka stanica spaja digitalizovanu građu sa kratkim kontekstom, a vremenska traka čuva redoslijed događaja.
intro.en: The exhibition follows the Montenegrin printed word through four turning points: the Oktoih from the Crnojević press, Njegoš’s The Ray of the Microcosm, The Mountain Wreath and the first issue of Glas Crnogorca. Each stop pairs digitized material with a short context, and the timeline keeps the events in order.

summary.me: Od razglednica iz 1912. do savremenih fotografija: primorje, rijeke, jezera i planine u galeriji sa video zapisima.
summary.en: From 1912 postcards to contemporary photographs: coast, rivers, lakes and mountains in a gallery with video.

description.me: Dronom snimljen pogled na Perast i ostrva u Bokokotorskom zalivu.
description.en: A drone view of Perast and the islets in the Bay of Kotor.

description.me: Plovidba i pogledi na Bokokotorski zaliv.
description.en: Sailing and views across the Bay of Kotor.

text.me: Razglednice iz vremena kada se Crna Gora oblikovala kao država u regionu.
text.en: Postcards from the time when Montenegro was taking shape as a state in the region.

title.en: Crown Prince Danilo at an artillery battery, postcard

text.me: Boka kotorska i Budva privlače putnike zbog starih gradova i mora.
text.en: The Bay of Kotor and Budva draw travellers with old towns and the sea.

text.me: Skadarsko jezero, Crno jezero na Durmitoru i kanjon Tare.
text.en: Lake Skadar, the Black Lake on Durmitor and the Tara canyon.

intro.me: Stare razglednice i savremene fotografije postavljene su jedne uz druge da se vidi kako su se mijenjali gradovi, jezera i planine. Svaki snimak možete uvećati i pročitati ko ga je napravio i pod kojom se licencom koristi.
intro.en: Old postcards and recent photographs are placed side by side to show how towns, lakes and mountains have changed. You can enlarge every picture and read who made it and under which licence it is used.

title.en: Along the Paths of the Written Word

summary.me: Priča na mapi: od Rijeke Crnojevića i Cetinja do Kotora, Podgorice i Durmitora, mjesta gdje se knjiga rađala i putovala.
summary.en: A story on the map: from Rijeka Crnojevića and Cetinje to Kotor, Podgorica and Durmitor, places where the book was born and travelled.

text.me: Na Rijeci Crnojevića, u središtu države Crnojevića, nastaje prva štamparija ovog prostora.
text.en: On Rijeka Crnojevića, at the heart of the Crnojević state, the first press of this region is established.

text.me: Cetinje postaje središte štampe, škola i prvih biblioteka. Fotohrom s kraja 19. vijeka prikazuje grad sa zapada.
text.en: Cetinje becomes the centre of printing, schools and the first libraries. A late 19th century photochrom shows the town from the west.

text.me: Preko Boke knjige i ideje stižu iz Venecije i Beča.
text.en: Through the Bay, books and ideas arrive from Venice and Vienna.

text.me: U 20. vijeku Podgorica preuzima ulogu administrativnog i kulturnog centra. Na slici je savremena Podgorica.
text.en: In the 20th century Podgorica takes over as the administrative and cultural centre. The picture shows Podgorica today.

text.me: Putopisci otkrivaju sjever i planine, a njihovi zapisi ostaju u fondu biblioteke. Na slici je putopis Kurta Hasserta o Crnoj Gori.
text.en: Travel writers discover the north and the mountains, and their notes remain in the library holdings. The picture shows Kurt Hassert’s travel book about Montenegro.

intro.me: Mapa vodi kroz mjesta u kojima je nastajala i putovala crnogorska pisana riječ. Stanice su poredane tako da se može pratiti put od Cetinja do drugih gradova i putopisa o Crnoj Gori.
intro.en: The map leads through the places where the Montenegrin written word was made and travelled. The stops are arranged so you can follow the route from Cetinje to other towns and to travel writing about Montenegro.

summary.me: Fotohromi s kraja 19. vijeka uz savremene poglede na ulice, manastir i okolinu Cetinja. Povucite klizač da uporedite.
summary.en: Late 19th century photochroms next to contemporary views of Cetinje’s streets, monastery and surroundings. Drag the handle to compare.

text.me: Isti grad u dva vremena: fotohrom s kraja 19. vijeka i snimak iz oktobra 2021.
text.en: The same town in two times: a late 19th century photochrom and a shot from October 2021.

text.me: Manastir nekad i sad: fotohrom i savremena fotografija.
text.en: The monastery then and now: a photochrom and a contemporary photograph.

text.me: Scena iz svakodnevnog života Cetinja krajem 19. vijeka.
text.en: A scene from everyday life in Cetinje at the end of the 19th century.

intro.me: Cetinje na starim ilustracijama i na današnjim fotografijama. Povucite klizač da uporedite isto mjesto nekada i sada.
intro.en: Cetinje in old illustrations and in present-day photographs. Drag the handle to compare the same place then and now.

title.en: Colours of Montenegro: A Virtual Hall

summary.me: Prošetajte virtuelnom salom i razgledajte fotografije gradova, jezera i planina. Pogledajte i video iz Budve.
summary.en: Walk through a virtual hall and explore photographs of towns, lakes and mountains. Also watch a video from Budva.

description.me: Novogodišnje veče u primorskom gradu Budvi.
description.en: New Year’s Eve in the coastal town of Budva.

text.me: Primorski i stari gradovi Crne Gore.
text.en: Coastal and historic towns of Montenegro.

text.me: Jezera, planine i kanjoni.
text.en: Lakes, mountains and canyons.

intro.me: Virtuelna sala sa fotografijama gradova, jezera i planina. Okrenite pogled, približite se okvirima i otvorite detalje o svakoj fotografiji.
intro.en: A virtual hall with photographs of towns, lakes and mountains. Look around, step closer to the frames and open the details of each photograph.

summary.me: Fotografije guslara i gusala: tradicija epskog pjevanja uz gusle koju dijele narodi zapadnog Balkana.
summary.en: Photographs of gusle players and instruments: the tradition of epic singing to the gusle shared by the peoples of the western Balkans.

text.me: Gusle prate epsko pjevanje na Balkanu. Fotografije guslara sa festivala iz 1927. i različitih vrsta gusala.
text.en: The gusle accompanies epic singing in the Balkans. Photographs of players at a 1927 festival and of different types of the instrument.

title.en: Gusle players at a gusle festival

summary.me: Radna verzija izložbe o crnogorskoj periodici.
summary.en: A working draft of an exhibition about Montenegrin periodicals.

text.me: Nacrt prve sekcije.
text.en: Draft of the first section.

summary.me: Prelistajte četiri djela koja su oblikovala crnogorsku štampanu riječ, od Oktoiha iz 1494. do prvog broja Glasa Crnogorca.
summary.en: Leaf through four works that shaped the Montenegrin printed word, from the Oktoih of 1494 to the first issue of Glas Crnogorca.

text.en: Petar II Petrović Njegoš publishes The Ray of the Microcosm, a philosophical poem about the place of man in the universe.

text.en: The Mountain Wreath, printed in Vienna in 1847, is regarded as the peak of Njegoš’s work and a foundational text of Montenegrin literature.

intro.me: Četiri djela koja su oblikovala crnogorsku štampanu riječ, postavljena kao knjiga koju listate. Na svakom razvijenom listu lijevo je slika, a desno kratak tekst, dok posljednja stranica navodi izvore i prava.
intro.en: Four works that shaped the Montenegrin printed word, laid out as a book you turn. Each spread has a picture on the left and a short text on the right, and the last page lists sources and rights.

summary.me: Deset fotografija mora, jezera i planina poređanih u prsten koji se polako okreće. Zaustavite ga kad vam se nešto dopadne.
summary.en: Ten photographs of the sea, lakes and mountains arranged in a slowly turning ring. Stop it whenever something catches your eye.

text.me: Boka kotorska i Budva privlače putnike zbog starih gradova i mora.
text.en: The Bay of Kotor and Budva draw travellers with old towns and the sea.

text.me: Skadarsko jezero, Crno jezero na Durmitoru i Rijeka Crnojevića, naselje koje nosi ime vladarske porodice.
text.en: Lake Skadar, the Black Lake on Durmitor and Rijeka Crnojevića, a town named after the ruling family.

text.me: Lovćen, kanjon Tare i Cetinje, nekadašnja prijestonica ispod Lovćena.
text.en: Lovćen, the Tara canyon and Cetinje, the old capital beneath Mount Lovćen.

intro.me: Deset fotografija poredanih u prsten koji se polako okreće. Zaustavite ga kad vam se nešto dopadne, pa otvorite detalje i uvećajte sliku.
intro.en: Ten photographs arranged in a slowly turning ring. Stop it when something catches your eye, then open the details and enlarge the picture.

summary.me: Šest kartica iz zbirke Montenegrina: knjige, list i dvije fotografije Cetinja. Izvucite karticu da vidite sve podatke o objektu.
summary.en: Six cards from the Montenegrina collection: books, a newspaper and two photographs of Cetinje. Pull out a card to see all the details of the object.

text.me: Tri knjige koje stoje na početku crnogorske štampane riječi i njene književnosti.
text.en: Three books that stand at the beginning of the Montenegrin printed word and its literature.

text.me: List koji je decenijama bilježio život Crne Gore.
text.en: A newspaper that for decades recorded the life of Montenegro.

text.me: Dvije fotografije u boji s kraja 19. vijeka iz World Digital Library.
text.en: Two colour photographs from the end of the 19th century from the World Digital Library.

intro.me: Kartice iz zbirke Montenegrina poredane kao u bibliotečkoj kartoteci. Izvucite karticu da vidite autora, godinu, zbirku, jezik, materijal i prava korišćenja, a klikom na sliku je uvećajte.
intro.en: Cards from the Montenegrina collection laid out like a library card catalogue. Pull out a card to see the author, year, collection, language, material and usage rights, and click the picture to enlarge it.
